turnTwo.derivation: The false Bool branch drops the Int message without changing count; it still constructs one Envelope with active=false. This turn imports the prior turn's 48-byte, 3-node live Envelope/Ticket/Leaf graph, which no longer contains Orphan, then promotes that same live graph.

roundTripCapacities.derivation: The round-trip body drops only the Unit, Bool, and Int messages and returns the two selected aliased Envelope roots. Import copies the full 56-byte, 4-node owner including Orphan; promotion returns only the 48-byte, 3-node Envelope/Ticket/Leaf graph.

postImportFailure.derivation: The failure body drops all five typed arguments and then executes 1 divided by 0. Exact 56-byte/4-node scratch capacities admit the complete initial owner import; the divide diagnostic must be raised only after that import and body execution. The same owner is then passed to the exact-capacity round-trip case, which returns the two selected Envelope roots.
